PART I

Item 1. Business

Northwind Logistics provides ground freight, air freight, and warehousing services across North America. We operate 39 distribution centres and a fleet of approximately 2,950 tractors. Our Ground segment is the largest of our three reportable segments by revenue and by headcount.

We were incorporated in Delaware in 1994 and our principal executive offices are located in Columbus, Ohio. Our services are sold through a direct sales force and through a network of freight brokers. Seasonality affects our results, with the fourth quarter historically the strongest.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

A significant portion of our Ground segment revenue is concentrated among a small number of customers. In fiscal 2023, our three largest customers accounted for approximately 31% of consolidated net revenue. The loss of any one of these customers could materially affect our results of operations.

Fuel price volatility affects our operating costs. While most customer contracts contain fuel surcharge provisions, these provisions may lag actual cost increases and may not recover the full amount of any increase.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition

Results of Operations. Total net revenue for fiscal 2023 was $3,800 million, an increase of 3.2% compared with $3,682 million in fiscal 2022. Growth was constrained by softer industrial demand in the first half of the year and by the loss of one regional customer in the Air Freight segment.

Segment results (in millions):

SegmentFY2023FY2022Change
Ground2,5802,461+4.8%
Air Freight842879-4.2%
Warehousing378342+10.5%
Total3,8003,682+3.2%

Operating expenses increased 3.6% to $3,457 million, slightly above the rate of revenue growth, producing operating margin contraction of 30 basis points. Purchased transportation was the largest single expense category.

Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

The consolidated financial statements and the report of our independent registered public accounting firm are included beginning on page F-1 of this Annual Report. We have prepared these statements in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States.

Our fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest to December 31. Fiscal 2023 contained 53 weeks and fiscal 2022 contained 52 weeks, which affects the comparability of certain period-over-period measures discussed above.
